name: QMines Limited
summary: QMines Limited is an Australian company exploring for and developing copper and gold. Its principal asset is a copper and gold mine at Mount Chalmers, about 316 square kilometers northeast of Rockhampton. It also holds the Silverwood project south of Warwick, about 234 square kilometers, and the Warroo project west of Stanthorpe, about 216 square kilometers, plus the Herries Range project.
